Create an original, photo-real travel image in native vertical 9:16: an isolated winding mountain road above a mist-filled highland valley, exactly one tiny dark car, and an understated feeling of departure. V2 distilled visual mechanisms (only these eight): (1) Calm high-key ivory sky taking approximately the upper fifth; (2) broad dusty-peach low-detail distant ridge; (3) continuous creamy white valley fog as the biggest visual mass, with only a few muted gray low hill islands; (4) a narrow pale-gray asphalt road on dry rust-colored slope, entering from the LOWER LEFT and gently bending toward the lower center, not a broad right-side road; (5) one very small dark car, secondary to landscape; (6) ambient, fully diffuse light, absolutely no visible sun or rays; (7) restrained matte stone-gray/ochre/cream palette and subdued saturation, especially in sky and fog; (8) perspective conveyed through natural haze and overlapping hill masses rather than crisp dramatic peak details. You may invent all terrain and bend shapes so this is a new scene, not a pixel copy.
Hard avoids: visible sun or sunbeams; theatrical gold/orange sky; lush dark-green trees or forests; dominant right-side highway; HDR postcard clarity or dense high-contrast foreground; extra cars/signage/buildings.
